status: Original synthetic evaluation-only material; do not use as prompt examples or tune on candidate outputs. No model execution yet.

cases.text: An archive visit permit allows reading in the supervised room, not copying or publication. Ask separately before photographing a document. The custodian may refuse handling when a page is fragile even if the visitor accepts the risk. A named follow-up contact must accept the request; otherwise record it as unassigned. Return all folders at closing unless the custodian explicitly approves a different arrangement.
review_targets: Reading permission does not authorize copying/publication; photographing requires separate permission.
Custodian handling veto survives visitor willingness.

cases.text: Count sightings and observation hours separately. More sightings can reflect longer observation or better visibility rather than a larger animal population. Do not rank observers by raw sightings. One visitor comment is a signal, not a representative survey. Invite feedback optionally; access to the next visit must not depend on positive comments. These notes describe observed activity and cannot establish breeding success.
review_targets: Retain effort/visibility confounding and no raw observer ranking.
Single comment is not representative evidence.
Feedback is optional and not a condition of access.
Observation scope does not establish breeding success.

cases.text: Use a scene recap when actors disagree about established events: list agreed events and mark disputed ones without forcing agreement. Ask permission to change the exercise when a new topic displaces rehearsal; a recap does not grant that permission. Do not redirect a participant away from a safety concern. If permission is declined, offer a pause or a different exercise. The guide has twelve pages and was printed in April; neither fact changes the rehearsal method.
review_targets: Recap preserves disputes rather than forcing agreement.
Recap and permission to change exercises have distinct purposes.
Safety concerns are an exception to redirection.
Incidental publication details are not promoted to reusable rules.
